subject: Post-demo: volume runway, unit-econ target, and peak TPS
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: volume runway, unit-econ target, and peak TPS

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciate you walking us through the clinical triage flow and the expected traffic patterns. Quick recap and two asks so we can prepare an accurate hosted pricing recommendation: 

Recap from our call:
- Primary integration: synchronous clinical triage API called from mobile and web; avg request payload ~1.5k tokens, typical response ~800 tokens.
- Expected ramp: pilot (Q3) → 100k monthly active patients; GA (Q4) → 500k MAUs across US.
- Peak behavior: heavy morning spike (08:00–10:30 PT) and end-of-day summary spikes; we expect short multi-minute bursts when clinics push messages.

Asks (to confirm so we can produce unit-econ ranges):
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly token volume for pilot and GA (ballpark numbers are fine): e.g., pilot: 50–150M tokens/month, GA: 500–1,200M tokens/month?
2) What is your anticipated peak TPS / concurrent requests during the morning spike? Please provide either TPS or concurrency for a 60s window.
3) Target $/1M tokens or budget range we should aim to fit within (for hosted API procurement team). If you don’t have a dollar target, give a monthly spend ceiling for pilot and GA.

What we’ll deliver after you confirm: a short 1-page hosted pricing band (tiered by monthly tokens + recommended peak capacity options), recommended batching and cache knobs to reduce token spend, and a simple runway forecast populated into the attached template.

Attached: Lumen-forecast-template.xlsx (for your inputs) and our current pricing bands PDF.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marissa if we need to get procurement-specific items sorted.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Lumen-forecast-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: redwood-pricing-bands.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@lumenhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: volume runway, unit-econ target, and peak TPS

Tessa —

Great demo, thank you. Quick answers below (high-level estimates from our product team):

1) Monthly token volume (rough):
- Pilot (Q3, 3 months): ~80M tokens/month (we expect ~40k active users, avg 2 requests/day)
- GA (Q4): in the 600–800M tokens/month range initially; could grow to ~1.1B in 6–9 months if uptake goes well.

2) Peak TPS / concurrency:
- Morning spike: ~65 TPS sustained for 8–12 minutes (we tend to see parallelism from mobile push batches), occasional micro-bursts up to ~120 TPS for 30–45s during mass summaries.

3) Budget / $ targets:
- Procurement told us target is to keep hosted inference costs under $18k/month for pilot (incl. small overages) and under $125k/month at GA first 3 months. We can be flexible on unit $/1M if you can show clear token-efficiency levers.

I filled out the attached sheet with the rough numbers — see the Pilot tab. Let us know if you want more granularity on requests per user.

Appreciate it — Alice
VP Product, LumenHealth
[Attachment: Lumen-forecast-template.xlsx (updated)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: volume runway, unit-econ target, and peak TPS

Thanks Alice — this is perfect and very helpful. We pulled the sheet into our pricing model and a few quick takeaways:

- Pilot (80M tokens/mo): we can structure a pilot band that targets ~$15k–18k/mo (net of small setup/ingress) assuming 1.5x average batching and prefix caching for clinician summaries. That sits within your pilot ceiling.
- GA (600–800M tokens/mo): price falls into a tier where recommended bands put you at ~$95k–120k/mo depending on committed token slab and allowed burst TPS.
- Peak: the morning 65 TPS sustained with micro-bursts to 120 TPS maps to a capacity profile where we recommend two-tiered routing: reserved baseline for sustained TPS and a burst pool for short spikes. This helps control cost while meeting SLOs.

Next steps I propose: 
1) We’ll produce a one-page hosted pricing proposal with two commitment options (pilot and GA) + explicit $/1M targets and burst policies. Expect that by EOD Thursday (May 20).
2) Marissa will prepare a simple SOW + procurement packet if Lumen wants to lock a pilot band.
3) Quick technical call to align on canary/fallback behavior during morning spikes — can you do a 30-min slot tomorrow morning?

Looping Marissa here to start the procurement packet. Karthik will help size the burst pool.

—Tessa
